title: Lumdum Dare 30 Challenge (2012)
subtitle: JavaSE, Android SDK, C.E.L.L. Theme (Complete a game in 30 days)
text: In 2012 I built a game called Bridge Captain for the 30 day Ludum Dare Challenge. The rules were to design, build, release and sell a game within the month of October. I ended up selling 300 copies within a couple of days of launch. However, I pulled it off the store in order complete the story mode. Link
